svg.title: DeltaFlow system and compute tile
svg.desc: Four compute tiles share instruction control. Each tile has sixteen independent 16 by 16 subarrays, 65 FP32 auxiliary lanes and 400 KiB SRAM. Sixteen DMA engines are separate system instances, four serving each tile.

text.font-family: Nimbus Roman, Times New Roman, serif
Nimbus Roman, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: One programmable compute fabric for GEMM and Gated DeltaNet attention
